attributes.description: Refined paired A/B regression decision dashboard. Per-rep metric → A/B pairing → B−A delta → predeclared equivalence boundary → computed PARITY/BETTER/WORSE verdict. Warmups excluded from verdict but stutter anomaly surfaced; null-game transition rows audited. Label parsing parameterized (GROK+SPLIT) so FC6 Proton 10/11 holdout renders without query edits. A = ge10-7, B = ge10-34.
